NeoSkriptPlaceholdersEvtPlaceholder.name: Custom Placeholder
description: Registers placeholders with PlaceholderAPI: the code runs each time a plugin asks for a placeholder with this prefix, and sets the result.
A relational placeholder (%rel_prefix_identifier%) is about two players: the first player and the second player.
examples:
placeholderapi relational placeholder with the prefix "teams":
	if the identifier is "same": # %rel_teams_same%
		set the result to "%{team::%the first player's uuid%} is {team::%the second player's uuid%}%"

NeoSkriptPlaceholdersExprPlaceholder.name: Placeholder
description: The placeholder asked for in a custom placeholder, without %, or the part of it before the first _ (the prefix) or after it (the identifier).
examples:
placeholderapi placeholder with the prefix "myserver":
	send "%the placeholder%: %the prefix% and %the identifier%" to console

NeoSkriptPlaceholdersExprResult.name: Placeholder Result
description: The value a custom placeholder gives. Set it to text or any other value, which becomes its text; delete or reset it for none, which leaves the placeholder as it is.

NeoSkriptPlaceholdersExprRelationalPlaye.name: Relational Placeholder Players
description: The two players in a custom relational placeholder: the one it's shown to, and the one it's about.
examples:
placeholderapi relational placeholder with the prefix "duel":
	set the result to "%the first player% vs %the second player%"

NeoSkriptPlaceholdersExprValue.name: Placeholder Value
description: The value of any plugin's PlaceholderAPI placeholder, for players or for nobody. The % around a placeholder can be left out when it's the whole text. A placeholder nothing answers gives nothing.
A relational placeholder takes two online players.
examples: set {_ping} to the placeholder "player_ping" from player
set {_status} to the relational placeholder "rel_friends_status" from player and arg-1
